_why: The host's answer for the two ring tools, taken live, so the parse is pinned to the shape Claude Code really keeps rather than to a shape typed here (martha#247). Taken on 2.1.322 (Claude Code) with @macula-io/mcp 0.51.2 as the session's one MCP server and a PostToolUse hook that kept its own body: one ring placed at another agent (answer 2, declined), one pending ring answered (answer 2, caller_notified 1). Each entry is that hook's tool_response, which is the value the relay's seam reads as body.answer: a bare one-block array [{type:'text', text}], with the whole block one JSON object, and a plain string on error. Every node id, petname, ring id and room topic was replaced with a synthetic value so no real one is in this public repository; nothing else was changed. Regenerate by taking the same two calls through a real host and rewriting the values.

tool_input.purpose: recording the shape of a ring result

tool_response.text:
